pages.heading: Crimson Mosquito
pages.body: Crimson Forests. It latches onto prey, feeds, then attacks with the blood it collected. An inflated mosquito can drop a Blood Sac. Sacs and its proboscis support

pages.heading: Crimson Mosquito (cont.)
pages.body: the Blood Sprayer weapon. An Overworld fly brought into the Nether can transform into this creature.
